title: Force the Block
setup: Black's knight on g6 can reach f8, and your bishop on b4 looks down the diagonal at that square.
hint: Black has exactly one way to answer a check on the eighth rank. Where does it put its knight?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rd8+}} leaves Black one legal move, {{Nf8}}, blocking. That square is not safe: the bishop on b4 covers it along the diagonal, so {{Rxf8#}} cannot be met by Kxf8. A forced block only defends if the blocking square is defended too.
